source_selection.selection_rule: performance first: four-seed E200 0.5 sourceV+0.5 worstsourceRX;exact ties V thenworstRX;costs secondary only after equalperformance

profile.mac_scope: Conv1d and matrix multiplication only; excludes FFT, normalization, pooling, physical lifts and elementwise arithmetic
profile.benchmark_peak_note: Disposable clone plus original frozen model resident; actual source-training peak is separately logged
profile.rf_mac_scope: Complex contractions implemented as tied real Conv1d and included in conv_linear MACs;radial protection,powers,observations excluded;actual elapsed/peak include all operations
